name: Danchizuma Danna ni wa Ienai Nakadashi Ganbou no Mappiruma
original_name: 団地妻 旦那には言えない中出し願望の真昼間
source:
A delivery man arrives at the apartment complex to deliver goods. There is always the temptation of married women who greet me as I do my job.

He becomes well acquainted with 2 married women in particular. A married woman who becomes addicted to the act of infidelity, and a frustrated married woman who is in search of a thrill.

As things progress, things start getting more and more intense...
translation:
送货员来到公寓楼送货。当我工作时，已婚妇女向我打招呼的诱惑总是存在。

他特别熟悉了两名已婚妇女。一个沉迷于不忠行为的已婚妇女，以及一个寻求刺激的沮丧的已婚妇女。

随着事情的进展，事情变得越来越激烈……
